D: A laundromat owner drowning in tax paperwork finds she can jump between universes to save the multiverse.
P: Serve the bagel bites when the everything bagel shows up.
S: Mini bagels with spring onion cream cheese and everything seasoning
Mini bagels halved and toasted, spread with spring onion cream cheese and showered in everything seasoning.
Hot dog fingers in puff pastry
the universe where everyone has hot dog fingers

Long thin frankfurts wrapped in strips of puff pastry with cheddar, baked golden and flaky, with mustard and tomato sauce for dunking. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 thawed puff pastry sheets into 1.5cm strips. Halve 8 thin frankfurts lengthways if thick, or use 16 cocktail franks. Lay a little grated cheddar (60g total) along each strip and wind it around a frank. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake on lined trays for 15 to 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
Pan-fried then steamed, with black vinegar and chilli oil
Pork and cabbage dumplings pleated by hand, pan-fried until crisp underneath, with black vinegar and chilli oil.
M: Hibachi steak and prawn fried rice
Seared sirloin and prawns with zucchini, egg fried rice, garlic butter
Beef, prawns and vegetables seared on a smoking hot plate with garlic butter and soy, with fried rice.
Longevity noodles with chicken and shiitake
the New Year party Evelyn is trying to throw at the laundromat

Long egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, shiitake, bok choy and oyster sauce, kept whole and never cut for a long life. Slice 400g chicken thigh and toss with 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tbsp soy. Soak 450g fresh long egg noodles in hot water 1 minute and drain. Mix 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp sesame oil. Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok 4 minutes. Add 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger and 150g sliced shiitake for 2 minutes, then 3 halved bok choy. Add noodles and sauce and toss 2 minutes without cutting.
W: Fried glutinous rice balls coated in sesame, filled with red bean paste
Glutinous rice dough filled with red bean paste, rolled in sesame seeds and fried until puffed and golden.
K: Chilled black milk tea with brown sugar tapioca pearls
Black tea with milk and brown sugar syrup over chewy tapioca pearls and ice.

d.note: Be kind, especially when we don't know what's going on.

dishes.make_ahead: Beat the cream cheese with the spring onions up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; toast and spread just before serving

steps.text: Halve and toast 8 mini bagels.
Beat the cream cheese with the finely sliced spring onions.
Spread thickly on each half and shower generously with the everything bagel seasoning.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and pleat the dumplings up to 1 day ahead on a floured tray in the fridge; fry and steam just before serving

steps.text: Mix the pork mince with the finely chopped cabbage, the soy sauce and the sesame oil.
Fill the dumpling wrappers and pleat closed.
Fry flat side down until golden, add the water, cover and steam 6 minutes.
Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

veg.make_ahead: Fry and cool the mushroom filling up to 1 day ahead; fill the wrappers, then fry and steam to serve

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in half the vegetable oil until dry, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the tofu, a quarter of the cabbage finely chopped, the soy sauce and the sesame oil.
Fill the dumpling wrappers and pleat closed.
Fry flat side down in the rest of the vegetable oil until golden, add the water, cover and steam 6 minutes.
Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

dishes.n: Hibachi steak and prawn fried rice
dishes.make_ahead: Cook and chill the rice the day before; sear the steak and prawns and fry the rice just before serving

steps.text: Cook the rice the day before.
Sear the sliced sirloin and the peeled prawns on a smoking plate with the garlic butter and soy.
Add sliced zucchini and onion.
Fry the rice with the eggs, butter and soy alongside, and serve everything together.

veg.n: Hibachi tofu and mushroom fried rice
veg.make_ahead: Cook and chill the rice the day before; sear the tofu and mushrooms and fry the rice on the night

steps.text: Cook the rice the day before.
Sear the sliced tofu and mushrooms on a smoking plate with the garlic butter made from half the butter and the crushed garlic, and half the soy.
Add sliced zucchini and onion.
Fry the rice with the eggs, remaining butter and soy alongside, and serve everything together.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and shape the balls up to 4 hours ahead under a damp cloth; fry just before serving

steps.text: Mix the glutinous rice flour with the sugar and the hot water into a soft dough.
Wrap the balls around teaspoons of red bean paste, wet and roll in the sesame seeds.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 160C for 6 minutes, pressing gently, until puffed and golden.

dishes.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead; cook the pearls within 4 hours of serving, as they go hard in the fridge

steps.text: Brew the black tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes and chill.
Cook the tapioca pearls as the packet says and toss in the brown sugar melted with the water.
Spoon pearls into glasses, add ice, the tea and the milk, and serve with wide straws.

s.note: Mini bagels with spring onion cream cheese and everything seasoning
s.how: Halve and toast 8 mini bagels. Beat 200g cream cheese with 3 finely sliced spring onions. Spread thickly on each half and shower generously with 2 tbsp everything bagel seasoning.

s.note: Pan-fried then steamed, with black vinegar and chilli oil
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups finely chopped cabbage, 2 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and pleat closed. Fry flat side down until golden, add 125ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes. Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

m.n: Hibachi steak and prawn fried rice
m.note: Seared sirloin and prawns with zucchini, egg fried rice, garlic butter
m.how: Cook 300g rice the day before. Sear 500g sliced sirloin and 300g peeled prawns on a smoking plate with 30g garlic butter and soy. Add sliced zucchini and onion. Fry the rice with 2 eggs, butter and soy alongside, and serve everything together.

w.note: Fried glutinous rice balls coated in sesame, filled with red bean paste
w.how: Mix 250g glutinous rice flour with 60g sugar and 200ml hot water into a soft dough. Wrap 16 balls around teaspoons of red bean paste (200g total), wet and roll in 80g sesame seeds. Fry at 160C for 6 minutes, pressing gently, until puffed and golden.

d.note: Chilled black milk tea with brown sugar tapioca pearls
d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 750ml boiling water for 5 minutes and chill. Cook 150g tapioca pearls as the packet says and toss in 80g brown sugar melted with 60ml water. Spoon pearls into 4 glasses, add ice, the tea and 250ml milk, and serve with wide straws.
